📈📉 ANC vs DA: every national and local election since 1994.

ANC: from a peak of 69.7% (2004) to 30.8% (2026).
DA: from 1.7% (1994, as the Democratic Party) to 24.6% (2026).

The ANC has fallen below 50% in the last three elections. The DA's growth has not been a straight line: it dipped in 2006, 2019 and 2021, and has climbed again since. And other parties now hold 44.6% of the vote.

Filled dots are national elections, open dots are local elections.

Source: IEC results.
